title: Avtolos (or Avtolmos) bar Reuven
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in [Sotah 49b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.49b.14) and Bava Kamma 83b: he was close to the government, and they therefore permitted him to cut his hair in the komi style.[^1]

notes.text: The two versions give Avtolos ben Reuven in Sotah and Avtolmos bar Reuven in [Bava Kamma 83a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.83a.3). Both explain the permission by his closeness to the government. Hyman cites 83b.
